page.overview:
Who is Nil?

Nil is a character from Stranger of Paradise Final Fantasy Origin. She is Jack Garland's superior and a member of the Lufenians. Nil was the overseer of the operations in Cornelia until Jack's defection, at which point she became obsessed to eradicate him by any means possible.

She is the overarching antagonist of Stranger of Paradise and appears prominently on the DLC episodes.

Nil was a high-ranking Lufenian operative in charge of Station 19, a facility resembling a white room amid a large open field, whose primary task was to oversee the operations of Cornelia by dumping the Lufenians' excessive darkness into the world and conduct experiments. Since too much darkness could risk developing into Chaos, an uncontrollable power that was deemed dangerous to the Lufenians' machinations, Nil was tasked with sending agents known as "Strangers" upon Cornelia to help regulate the darkness. Otherwise, they would utilize the Dimensional Crystal Matrix, granted to them by a mysterious collaborator, to cause a time loop with the resultant energy serving as the collaborator's compensation.

Jack Garland was a combatant under her direct supervision and a veteran Stranger agent whom she had sent on repeated missions. As a safety precaution for operations to work smoothly, Jack's memory would be wiped during each departure, being bestowed with a dark crystal that would help prevent Jack's memories from surfacing inconveniently and otherwise warn him to be picked up when its capacity was overwhelmed.
